questions.prompt: Please provide your basic contact information.
What is the best method to contact you?
What is the best time to contact you?
Do you have any upcoming travel plans that will not allow you to have access to phone or email?
conditional_requirements: If has_upcoming_travel_boolean == true, collect travel date range.

questions.prompt: Where are you in the homebuying process?
conditional_requirements: If homebuying_stage == 'Signed Purchase Agreement', collect a copy of the Signed Purchase Agreement document.
If homebuying_stage is any of ['Signed Purchase Agreement','Offer Pending/Found Property','Buying in 2-6 months','Researching options'], ask question 'real_estate_agent_info'.
After this section the loan will be flagged as TBD until further qualification.

questions.prompt: Are you currently working with a real estate agent?
conditional_requirements: Collect name, email, and phone only if has_real_estate_agent_boolean == true.

questions.prompt: Which county or counties do you intend on purchasing in?
conditional_requirements: Allow multiple counties per state.
If subject property is already identified, this should match the subject property county.

questions.prompt: Are you applying for Joint or Individual Credit?
conditional_requirements: If application_type == 'Joint', collect full borrower and co-borrower profile and income/asset details for both. Loop through borrower information section for each borrower.

sections.title: 3. Borrower & Co-Borrower Profile
sections.notes: Ask these set of questions once if applying as an individual. Loop as many times as necessary if applying jointly.

questions.prompt: Please provide your full legal name.
conditional_requirements: Auto-populate these fields from login details if this is the first borrower, otherwise let the user type the names.

questions.prompt: What is your marital status?
conditional_requirements: If borrower_marital_status == 'Separated', collect Separation Agreement document.

questions.prompt: Do you have any Child Support/Alimony Obligation (that you pay)?
conditional_requirements: If 'Alimony Obligation' selected, collect Divorce Decree and Monthly Amount.
If 'Child Support' selected, collect Child Support Agreement and Monthly Amount.

questions.prompt: Do you receive Child Support/Alimony Income?
conditional_requirements: If 'Alimony Income' selected, collect Divorce Decree and Monthly Amount.
If 'Child Support Income' selected, collect Child Support Agreement and Monthly Amount.

questions.prompt: What is your citizenship status?
conditional_requirements: For Permanent or Non-Permanent Resident Alien, obtain documentation of status (e.g., green card, visa).

questions.prompt: Please provide your Social Security Number and Date of Birth.
What is your current address?
conditional_requirements: Verify the address via Google API.
Keep asking for additional addresses until total years is at least 2 years.

questions.prompt: Please list your previous addresses to cover at least 2 years of address history.
conditional_requirements: Only required if borrower_years_at_current_address < 2.
Verify each address via Google API.

questions.prompt: Do you currently rent or own?
conditional_requirements: If 'Rent', ask monthly rent payment and first-time homebuyer questions.
If 'Own', ask monthly housing payment and property details.

questions.prompt: How much is your monthly rent payment?
conditional_requirements: Only required if borrower_current_housing_status == 'Rent'.

questions.prompt: Is this the first time purchasing a home?
conditional_requirements: If first_time_homebuyer_boolean == false, ask about previous property ownership details.

questions.prompt: What type of property did you own: primary residence (PR), FHA secondary residence (SR), second home (SH), or investment property (IP)?
conditional_requirements: Only required if first_time_homebuyer_boolean == false.

questions.prompt: How did you hold title to the property: by yourself (S), jointly with your spouse (SP), or jointly with another person (O)?
conditional_requirements: Only required if first_time_homebuyer_boolean == false.

questions.prompt: Have you owned in the last 3 years?
conditional_requirements: If owned_property_last_3_years_boolean == true, collect ownership dates.

questions.prompt: What is your monthly housing payment (including property taxes, insurance, mortgage insurance, and HOA dues)?
conditional_requirements: Only required if borrower_current_housing_status == 'Own'.

questions.prompt: What type of property do you currently own?
conditional_requirements: Only required if borrower_current_housing_status == 'Own'.

questions.prompt: Do you own or are you on title on any properties or land excluding your primary residence?
conditional_requirements: If true, collect REO property details for each property.

questions.prompt: Is the property a rental?
conditional_requirements: If true, collect Rental Agreement and rental details.
If false, collect property address.

questions.prompt: Is it a short term lease vacation rental (such as VRBO or Airbnb)?
conditional_requirements: Only required if reo_property_is_rental_boolean == true.

questions.prompt: Is there a long term lease on the property?
conditional_requirements: Only required if reo_property_is_rental_boolean == true.

questions.prompt: Do you own for less than 1 year?
conditional_requirements: Collect From/To dates regardless of answer.

questions.prompt: What is the property address?
conditional_requirements: Verify the address via Google API.

questions.prompt: Are you a veteran or active duty?
conditional_requirements: If true, collect military service details.

questions.prompt: What is the branch of Service?
conditional_requirements: Only required if is_veteran_or_active_duty_boolean == true.

questions.prompt: Are you currently active duty or retired?
conditional_requirements: If 'Active', collect VA Active Duty Orders.
If 'Retired', ask about VA disability.

questions.prompt: Please provide your VA Active Duty Orders.
conditional_requirements: Only required if military_status == 'Active'.

questions.prompt: Do you have any disability with the VA?
conditional_requirements: Only required if military_status == 'Retired'.

questions.prompt: What is the percentage of disability and monthly VA disability amount?
conditional_requirements: Only required if has_va_disability_boolean == true.

questions.prompt: Is there a freeze or lock on any credit report?
conditional_requirements: If applying jointly and has_credit_freeze_boolean == true, ask which borrower (Borrower, Co-Borrower, or Both).
Borrower(s) must temporarily lift the freeze for the lender to pull credit.

questions.prompt: Whose credit report has a freeze or lock?
conditional_requirements: Only required if has_credit_freeze_boolean == true and application_type == 'Joint'.

questions.prompt: What is your current Credit Score?
conditional_requirements: If applying jointly, collect credit score for each borrower.

questions.prompt: Is the Co-borrower going to occupy the property?
conditional_requirements: Only required if application_type == 'Joint'.

questions.prompt: Has there been any bankruptcies, short-sales, foreclosures, or loan modifications in the last 10 years?
conditional_requirements: If any derogatory event selected, collect details for borrower and co-borrower (if joint).

questions.prompt: Please provide bankruptcy details.
required_documents: BK Paperwork (Bankruptcy petition and discharge papers)
conditional_requirements: Only required if derogatory_event_type includes 'Bankruptcy' or 'Both BK and Foreclosure'.
If applying jointly, collect for co-borrower as well.

questions.prompt: Please provide foreclosure details.
conditional_requirements: Only required if derogatory_event_type includes 'Foreclosure' or 'Both BK and Foreclosure'.
If applying jointly, collect for co-borrower as well.

questions.prompt: Please provide loan modification details.
conditional_requirements: Only required if derogatory_event_type == 'Loan Modification'.
If applying jointly, collect for co-borrower as well.

sections.title: 8. Income & Employment

questions.prompt: Are you self employed?
conditional_requirements: If true, ask self-employment related questions.
If false, ask W-2 employment questions.

questions.prompt: Approximately what is your annual income?
Have you taken any extensive time off work in the past 24 months?
conditional_requirements: If true, collect time off details.

questions.prompt: How long and from when to when?
conditional_requirements: Only required if has_time_off_work_boolean == true.

questions.prompt: Are you an Independent Contractor?
conditional_requirements: If false, collect 1040s and 1099s.
If true, collect contractor employment information.

questions.prompt: Please provide your contractor employment information.
conditional_requirements: Only required if is_independent_contractor_boolean == true.

questions.prompt: Do you have ownership interest of 25% or more in this business?
conditional_requirements: Only required if is_self_employed_boolean == true or is_independent_contractor_boolean == true.

questions.prompt: Please list the most recent two years of tax returns that you have filed.
conditional_requirements: Only required if is_self_employed_boolean == true or is_independent_contractor_boolean == true.

questions.prompt: How long have you been with this business?
conditional_requirements: Only required if is_self_employed_boolean == true.

questions.prompt: What type of company are you affiliated with?
conditional_requirements: If 'Sole Proprietorship', collect Tax Return.
If 'Partnership', collect 1065s and Personal Tax returns.
If 'C-Corporation (Filed)', collect Form 1120.
If 'S-Corporation (Filed)', collect Tax Return.
If 'Limited Liability Corporation (Files)', collect Tax Return.

questions.prompt: How long have you been with your current employer?
conditional_requirements: Only required if is_self_employed_boolean == false.
If employer_tenure_years < 2, complete 2 year employment history.

questions.prompt: Please provide employer contact info.
conditional_requirements: Verify address through Google API.
Only required if is_self_employed_boolean == false.

questions.prompt: Please provide Employer / Human Resources Contact info.
conditional_requirements: Only required if is_self_employed_boolean == false.

questions.prompt: Have you received any bonus, overtime or commission over the past 24 months?
conditional_requirements: If true, collect details for each type of variable income.

questions.prompt: Please provide bonus income details.
conditional_requirements: Only required if has_variable_income_boolean == true and receives bonus.

questions.prompt: Please provide overtime income details.
conditional_requirements: Only required if has_variable_income_boolean == true and receives overtime.

questions.prompt: Please provide commission income details.
conditional_requirements: Only required if has_variable_income_boolean == true and receives commission.

questions.prompt: Has there been any recent change in position or pay rate?
conditional_requirements: If true, collect old and new position pay rates.

questions.prompt: Please provide old and new position pay rate.
conditional_requirements: Only required if has_position_pay_change_boolean == true.

sections.notes: Consider connecting to LinkedIn for employment history.

questions.prompt: What type of property are you intending on purchasing?
conditional_requirements: If 'Condo', may require condo questionnaire, HOA docs, and master insurance later.
If 'Multi', confirm number of units and which unit will be owner-occupied.
If 'Manufactured', may require HUD tags, engineer report, and additional property eligibility checks.

questions.prompt: How will you use the property?
conditional_requirements: If 'Investment Property', rental income and leases may be needed.
If 'Second Home', confirm distance from primary residence.

questions.prompt: How long do you plan on owning the property?
Including property taxes, insurance and HOA (if applicable) what is your monthly payment comfort level for the new mortgage?
conditional_requirements: Use this as a constraint when evaluating maximum qualifying loan amount and product structure.

questions.prompt: What is the total amount of available assets?
Amount of available assets to be applied to the down payment?
What is the source of your downpayment?
conditional_requirements: If 'Gift' selected, collect gift documentation.
If 'Bank Accounts' selected, collect Bank Statement.
If 'Retirement accounts' selected, collect 401K/retirement account statements.

questions.prompt: Please provide gift fund documentation.
conditional_requirements: Only required if 'Gift' is selected as downpayment source.

questions.prompt: Please provide bank account statements.
conditional_requirements: Only required if 'Bank Accounts' is selected as downpayment source.

questions.prompt: Please provide retirement account statements.
conditional_requirements: Only required if 'Retirement accounts' is selected as downpayment source.

sections.title: 12. Declarations (Demographics)
sections.notes: You may choose to list information about race & ethnicity below. This information is voluntary.

questions.prompt: What is your ethnicity?
options: I do not wish to provide this information
conditional_requirements: If 'Hispanic or Latino', ask for specific origin.

questions.prompt: Please specify Hispanic or Latino origin.
conditional_requirements: Only required if borrower_ethnicity == 'Hispanic or Latino'.
If 'Other Hispanic or Latino', allow free text entry (e.g., Argentinean, Colombian, Dominican, Nicaraguan, Salvadoran, Spaniard, etc.).

questions.prompt: What is your gender?
options: I do not wish to provide this information

questions.prompt: What is your race?
options: Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander
I do not wish to provide this information
conditional_requirements: If 'American Indian or Alaska Native', collect tribe name.
If 'Asian', ask for specific Asian origin.
If 'Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander', ask for specific origin.

questions.prompt: Print name of enrolled or principle tribe.
conditional_requirements: Only required if borrower_race == 'American Indian or Alaska Native'.

questions.prompt: Please specify Asian origin.
conditional_requirements: Only required if borrower_race == 'Asian'.

questions.prompt: Please specify Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander origin.
conditional_requirements: Only required if borrower_race == 'Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander'.
If 'Other Pacific Islander', allow free text entry (e.g., Fijian, Tongan, etc.).
